title: Pharmacy
subtitle: Manage your prescriptions and refills
loadErrorDescription: We could not confirm your current prescriptions. Try syncing again.
pickupErrorDescription: The pharmacy did not return a valid code for this prescription. Sync before trying again.
refillDescription: The server authorized this refill. Sync to check its prescription and billing status.
refillErrorDescription: We could not confirm this refill. Sync or contact the pharmacy before making another request.
billingErrorDescription: We could not identify one confirmed payable bill for this prescription. Review billing or contact support.
refillReview: Check refill status before another request
instructionsUnknown: Instructions unavailable — check with your prescriber
pharmacyDescription: Confirm pickup location and opening hours with your pharmacy.
interactionDescription: Ask your pharmacist or prescriber to review interactions. This page does not establish that an interaction check has been completed.
qrDescription: Show this prescription's code to the pharmacist.
approvedTemplate: {medication} is billed and waits for the patient's payment before pickup.
restoredTemplate: {medication} was never collected, so no new refill was charged.
approveUnconfirmedDescription: We could not confirm this approval. Refresh the list and check its status before approving again.
restoredUnpaidTemplate: {medication} was never collected, so no new refill was charged. Its existing bill must be paid before pickup.
approveRejectedDescription: The pharmacy service did not apply this approval. Refresh the list to see the prescription's current state.
refillRejectedDescription: The pharmacy did not accept this refill request. Sync to see the prescription's current state.
